title: Vampire Vape Arctic Fruit Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Revitalise your taste buds with Arctic Fruit, a potent fusion of luscious tropical fruits and bold, spicy aniseed, dramatically transformed by an icy-cold kick of Menthol. The cooling component elevates the tangy fruit flavours, amplifying the overall taste and electrifying your senses. Arctic skilfully harmonises the sweetness of exotic fruits with the refreshment of an arctic breeze. Surrender to the crisp embrace of this captivating blend and experience the ultimate sensory satisfaction. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
